name: pali-memory
description: Registers the Pali memory MCP server and installs its GitHub Copilot hooks.

pali.branch.description: Branch used for push and pull.

pali.checkUpdates.description: Automatically check for pali updates on extension startup.

pali.path.description: Path to the pali executable, or its name if it is on PATH. When a binary is auto-installed, this is updated to the absolute path of the installed binary.

pali.remoteUrl.description: Git remote for the memory repository: an HTTPS or SSH URL, or an absolute path to a local repository. Empty runs local-only, with no push or pull.

pali.remoteSync.description: Pull every repository from the remote before startup index freshness is decided, and refuse to start when pali.remoteUrl is not set. Requires a non-empty pali.remoteUrl.

pali.repoPath.description: Git-backed memory repository. Empty uses the pali default (~/.memory-mcp).

pali.scope.description: Memory scope for hooks. Empty uses the workspace folder's git repository name.

pali.scanBlame.description: Record per-line commit IDs from git blame in the scan manifest. Only commit IDs and line numbers are written, never author names, emails, or source lines.

pali.scanMaxFileBytes.description: Maximum size in bytes of a file included by Pali: Scan Repositories.

pali.scanSaveMemories.description: Save the codebase insight digest as the codebase-insights memory in the memory repository. Uses pali.repoPath and pali.scope.

pali.logLevel.description: Log level for the extension, the MCP server (RUST_LOG), and the Copilot hooks (PALI_HOOK_LOG_LEVEL). Debug output is useful when diagnosing recall or sync problems.

pali.modelPath.description: Directory containing the embedding model files (config.json, tokenizer.json, model.safetensors). Empty uses the model auto-installed by the extension, or the platform default when none is installed. A directory missing any of the files is reported and ignored.

scripts.build: npm run build:binary && npm run compile
scripts.prepare: npm run compile && npm run icon
scripts.reinstall: npm run pkguninstall & npm run pkginstall
scripts.clean: rm -rf out node_modules target pali-memory-*.vsix tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run icon
